summary: This component displays the dashboard for an event organizer, showing organization details, current event details, and a list of registered students. It also includes a button to add a new event.
evidence: The component uses React hooks like useEffect and useState to manage state and fetch data from the backend.
It uses axios to make HTTP requests to the backend API to retrieve organization and student information.
The component displays the organization's name, contact, and email, as well as the total number of registered students.
It includes a button to navigate to the event creation page.
